text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide loses the autumn<n>Tenno Sho. Even
so, she feels proud<n>of her performance.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Tears well up in Biwa Hayahide's<n>eyes as she
realizes how much<n>she's grown. She's no longer
that<n>girl who once lost to her sister and<n>injured
herself.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Together, we've perfected a winning<n>equation to
beat her younger sister,<n>Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Only two months remain until we<n>unveil it at the
Arima Kinen.
